units.source_text: 在一同目送俄国女人的内掌柜的邀请之下，岛村走到了帐房，看见一个身材高大的女子背向他坐在炉边。

en.t: At the invitation of the innkeeper's wife, who had been seeing the Russian woman off with him, Shimamura went to the office and saw a tall woman sitting with her back to him by the hearth.

units.source_text: 女子撩起衣服下摆站了起来。

en.t: The woman lifted the hem of her clothing and stood up.

units.source_text: 她穿着一身带家徽的黑礼服。

en.t: She was wearing a black formal kimono marked with a family crest.
